hypothesis: A parameter-matched causal cross-token readout adapter can make the queried memory key control generation better than a per-token MLP adapter, when the inherited G8C backbone is frozen.

arms.query_readout_attention: four 96x96 projections plus scalar residual gate

optimizer: fresh AdamW on adapter only; lr cosine .001 to .0001; betas(.9,.95), wd .01, clip1
objective: positive completion NLL only; F=<integer>+EOS; identical examples and updates in both arms

data.denied: all available G5S/G8C groups and every G9QRP3 generated group
data.split: query-invariant memory-history groups before rendering; per-key chronology retained

inference: prompt-only greedy byte259; max32 bytes; EOS; strict F=<integer>; no solver/gold/case object
selection: fixed step200 only; validation/held never select checkpoints
scope: small paired architectural mechanism screen, not 300-800M and not Qwen parity
